resources.string: Saving is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
Open a webpage and wait for it to finish loading before saving.
The candidate has expired. Detect media on the current page again.
This resource is protected or its format is unsupported. Saving has not started.
② Stream saving requires a valid entitlement. This development version has no real purchase entry point.
An existing save or system media verification operation is still shutting down. Please try again later.
A short-lived request session could not be established safely. Saving has not started.
① The Direct download task has been accepted. View its progress in Save tasks.
② Stream saving is temporarily unavailable. Check your entitlement and wait for existing tasks to shut down.
A short-lived request session could not be established.
The stream inspection queue is temporarily unavailable. Saving has not started.
The page, source, or entitlement has changed. Check again.
Save task capacity is full. Existing media has not been deleted.
A save operation is already in progress.
② The Stream task has been accepted with the selected quality fixed. It completes only after the standalone MP4 passes verification.
The recording session was interrupted. The old consent cannot be reused. Explicitly start a new recording; the old task can be abandoned.
The stream segments are incomplete. Return to the webpage and select a fixed quality again. The new task starts over; the old task can be cancelled.
The full source address is not retained after a restart. Return to the webpage to detect and select media again. The new task downloads from the beginning; the old task can be cancelled.
Open and sign in to a same-origin page for this resource in the browser, then return and resume manually.
A short-lived request session could not be established safely. Saving has not resumed.
The task state cannot be read right now. Private files have been retained for recovery.
The save execution queue is temporarily unavailable. The task has been paused.
③ Recording cannot start right now. Check your recording entitlement and wait for existing save or preview resources to shut down.
Task capacity or display dimensions are unsuitable for starting a recording.
The recording session is still shutting down. Start again later.
A valid recording configuration could not be established.
The region, entitlement, or media resources are not ready. Check the region again and wait for existing tasks to shut down.
The current display geometry, entitlement, or media resources are not ready. No preview was acquired and recording has not started.
The system could not start this foreground recording service. The old consent has been discarded. Start again manually.
The recording task could not finish. Private files have been retained for local recovery.
System recording resources have not been confirmed released. The foreground state and files have been retained; another recording cannot start. If necessary, fully stop the app through the system.
Under the existing contract, pause and resume require both recording and segment-recording entitlements.
Save storage is temporarily unavailable. Existing media has not been cleared.
Too many task operations are pending. Please try again later.
The page or tab has changed. Tap Save again on the current page.
JavaScript is currently disabled. After enabling it, tap Save on the page to run one detection.
Page detection timed out. Downloading has not started.
This resource is a blob or another unsupported type. Only HTTPS MP4 and restricted static HLS are supported.
No detectable video was found on the current main page. Cross-origin players, blobs, or nested pages may not be detectable.
The detection data returned by the page could not be read safely. Downloading has not started.
Saving is waiting for a confirmed default Wi-Fi connection. Connect to Wi-Fi or turn off Save only over Wi-Fi, then retry manually.
The task was cancelled. It will not automatically switch to another saving method.
This resource requires a valid signed-in session or access permission.
There is not enough available storage space.
Private storage is temporarily unavailable. Existing media has not been cleared.
The operation timed out. Late results will not be committed.
The network operation did not complete within bounded retries. Please try again later.
The secure connection to the website could not be verified. Certificate checks were not bypassed.
The resource address or connection does not meet the safety restrictions.
The file-size or cumulative transfer budget for this development version has been reached.
Protected content was detected. Saving is not supported.
This media or saving method is outside the compatibility scope of this development version. Network saving does not support live streams, encryption, separate tracks, format changes, or transcoding.
The file is incomplete or did not pass actual media verification. It was not added to the library as a successfully saved video.
The source resource or resume identity does not match. Mismatched bytes were not joined.
The candidate resource has expired. Return to the webpage and detect media again.
System resources have not been confirmed released. Task files are retained and late results will not be committed.
System media verification resources are not available yet. Please try again later.
The commit state needs to be verified again. Files have been retained for recovery.
The website is limiting requests. Please try again later.
The short-lived source context has been cleared. Return to the webpage to detect and select media again; the new task downloads from the beginning.
The resource no longer exists (404). Return to the webpage and select it again.
The website rejected this resource request. No automatic switch to another saving method was made.
The website did not return complete media that can be saved.
A task is already in progress. Please try again later.
System consent for this recording was not obtained. Recording has not started.
Internal audio permission was not granted. Explicitly choose to start again without audio, or cancel.
The system cannot start this recording right now. The old consent will not be reused.
The device encoder does not support this recording configuration.
Valid recording samples are empty or too short. No finished video was published.
Waiting for a recording keyframe timed out. A complete finished video has not been confirmed.
The recorded media timeline does not meet the requirements. No finished video was published.
Internal playback audio capture failed. No automatic switch to the microphone or to recording without audio was made.
The system recording encoder failed. Successful saving has not been confirmed.
The recording file was not fully finalized. No finished video was published.
The task did not complete. Check the page and storage, then try again.
